class.name: forest_nav::DynamicObstacleLayer
class.description: Costmap layer for MOVING, NON-CONVEX obstacles. Stamps the predicted swept volume of tracked dynamic obstacles, rasterises concave support outlines as measured, and clears by confidence decay rather than by ray-casting -- because a canopy occludes real trunks constantly and ray-cast clearing deletes them. NOT COMPILED AND NOT RUN: no ROS 2 build exists here.
